title: Add a new customer
statementMd:
Insert a customer named `Zed Park` from `Korea` (email `zed@example.com`, signup date `2024-07-01`, id 11), then list all customers from Korea or Japan.

Expected columns: `name`, `country`.

Tables: `customers`, `products`, `orders`, `order_items`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
INSERT INTO customers (id, name, email, country, signup_date) VALUES (11, 'Zed Park', 'zed@example.com', 'Korea', '2024-07-01'); SELECT name, country FROM customers WHERE country IN ('Korea', 'Japan');
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
